Intro: Why…are you…so afraid? Is it not a chef's duty…to serve the public? To control…your own emotions…to service others?
Yet…hmm…you turn away those who were…clean of Spoilage. How odd…and…how expected.
The power to reject…do you deserve this? I desire…a taste…of your spoiled food. Need…to determine…if you are…hmm…worthy.
Success: ...you have resolve, despite your lack of…hmm…care. We shall see…if we meet again.
Fail: ...quick to scorn others as spoiled…yet unable to justify it…hmm…pitiful. You do not deserve…the power to control.
